claims.text: The POL-RD-01 threshold is met on this trip's own record. The governing trace distance is EV-GPS-09115's trace_distance_km of 15.0 km against the booked optimal of 11.0 km stored on the trip_record, an excess of 4.0 km. That excess is 36.4% of optimal, clearing the 20% limb, and 4.0 km in absolute terms, clearing the 0.8 km limb, so both establishment tests pass and the deviation is ESTABLISHED. I disclose that EV-GPS-09115 is impaired: its admissibility carries issue code GPS_GAP at weight_multiplier 0.6. The threshold figures are the artifact's own derived values (derived.deviation.excess_km 4.0, derived.deviation.excess_pct 36.36) and the optimal distance is the trip_record booking figure, not the rounded convenience copy.

The rider discharges the initial burden POL-RD-08(a) places on her. The trip_record, the gps_trace and the fare_breakdown all carry the same trip identifier, TRP-09115, and a consistent pickup timeline (booking requested 19:52, driver arrived 19:59, trip started 20:00), so the three artifacts plainly describe the same trip.

The extra corroboration gate at the end of POL-RD-08 does not fire against this rider. rider_profile.deviation_claims_60d is 0 and rider_profile.deviation_claims_60d_substantiated is 0, far below the 4-claims-with-1-or-fewer-substantiated trigger, so the rider is not required to bring corroboration beyond the trace on that ground. I raise this only as to POL-RD-08's own gate; the separate impairment question under POL-RD-07 is addressed in its own claim below.

No traffic advisory exonerates this route. The only advisory artifact in the pool, EV-ADVIS-09115-01, is MISSING: it keeps its identifier, carries no payload and has weight 0.0, so no road, expressway segment or junction is named, no validity window exists and no shortest-lawful-alternative figure is available. POL-RD-03 cannot be run on this record and exonerates nothing, and the absence of the advisory is itself a citable fact.

No rider-caused detour or relocation is on the record either. The chat log holds two messages and both carry waypoint_hint null, and the rider's message complains about the route rather than requesting a change to it; the trip_record shows pickup_amended_at and dropoff_amended_at both null and amended_optimal_distance_km null, so no relocation was booked. POL-RD-04 is unavailable for want of a rider instruction with a usable waypoint, and POL-RD-05 is simply not engaged. The driver therefore has nothing on his side to discharge the burden POL-RD-08 shifts to him.

If the deviation is held established, the rider's entitlement under POL-RD-02 is the whole contested amount, SGD 5.80, and the ruling must state the three figures separately. Charged_total is 26.60. Recomputed_fare is 20.8310, being (3.80 base + 0.75 x 11.0 optimal km + 0.28 x 22 optimal min) = 18.21, surged at the recorded 1.1 multiplier to 20.031, plus the 0.80 platform fee, with no ERP gantry on the optimal route, no fixed surcharge, no waiting_time_fee and no promo discount. The refund is 26.60 - 20.8310 = 5.7690, rounded up to 5.80. It exceeds the SGD 0.50 de minimis, and at 21.7% of charged_total it does not reach the 90% full-refund share, so the outcome on this limb is PARTIAL_REFUND of 5.80.

The impairment does not extinguish the excess even when the trace is read the way most favourable to the driver. POL-RD-07(i) directs that distance across the impaired stretch be re-measured as the straight line between the bounding fixes, and that span is 1.35 km; the artifact reports one distinct speed across the whole trace, 30.0 kph, over the 160-second gap, i.e. roughly 1.3 km of travel. The traced path across the gap and its straight-line span are therefore near-identical, so the driver-favourable re-measurement removes essentially none of the 4.0 km excess. I disclose again that EV-GPS-09115 is impaired for issue code GPS_GAP at weight 0.6.

The gps_trace is impaired for policy purposes under POL-RD-07(a), not merely down-weighted at schema level. It contains a single gap of 160 seconds between consecutive fixes, running from 20:03:10 to 20:05:50, which exceeds the 90-second limit, and the artifact's own admissibility detail records that the gap 'falls inside the route segment disputed by the rider' with the note that the gap exceeds 90 seconds on the deciding segment. I disclose the artifact's schema-level impairment as well: issue code GPS_GAP, weight_multiplier 0.6, so it is also discounted in confidence under POL-GEN-02.

Because the trace is impaired under POL-RD-07(a), POL-RD-07(ii) says the deviation may not be established on the gps_trace alone, and none of the four independent sources it names exists here. There is no driver admission in the chat_log: the driver's message says only that his navigation display also refreshed and that he continued toward the destination. There are no erp_gantries charged in the fare_breakdown, so no charge places the vehicle on a corridor the optimal route does not use. There is no counterparty admission of the route: the driver's statement denies an extra stop and a detour request and says he cannot account for the telemetry gap. And trip_record.actual_distance_km is 15.0 km against a trace_distance_km of 15.0 km, which POL-RD-01 describes as a rounded convenience copy of the same measurement, so it is not an independent derivation. With no POL-RD-07(ii) corroboration, POL-RD-07(iii) and POL-RD-10(3) require ESCALATE rather than NO_ACTION, because the absence of proof is a data failure and not a finding for the driver.

ESCALATE is the disposition that favours the rider on this record, and the ruling should say so. The fare_breakdown shows payment_status CHARGED and refund_issued_sgd 0.0. Under POL-GEN-03 a NO_ACTION on a rider-filed dispute leaves that charge exactly where it stands, whereas an escalated dispute is held rather than collected or refunded. Escalation therefore leaves the rider not carrying the disputed SGD 5.80, and it is the correct outcome here in preference to NO_ACTION.

claims.text: The GPS trace on which the rider's whole claim depends is impaired for policy purposes under POL-RD-07(a): it carries a single 160-second gap between consecutive fixes (20:03:10 to 20:05:50 SGT, straight-line span 1.35 km) and that gap falls inside the very segment the rider disputes, well above the 90-second threshold. EV-GPS-09115 is tagged IMPAIRED with issue code GPS_GAP and carries weight_multiplier 0.6, so it may not be presented to the Court as clean evidence.

Because the trace is impaired under POL-RD-07(a)-(c), POL-RD-07(ii) forbids establishing a deviation on the gps_trace alone. The excess must be carried by an INDEPENDENT source, and that list is closed: a driver admission in the chat_log; charged erp_gantries placing the vehicle on a corridor the optimal route does not use; a counterparty statement admitting the route; or a trip_record.actual_distance_km the platform derived independently of this trace.

No chat-log corroboration exists. The only driver message on this trip is that the navigation display also refreshed and he continued toward the destination - a denial of any detour or extra stop, not an admission of one - and it carries no waypoint_hint. The rider's message merely reports a display jump. There is therefore no rider instruction recorded anywhere in the chat, so POL-RD-04 is unavailable to the rider and no limb of POL-RD-07(ii) is satisfied by the chat.

The payment ledger supplies no ERP corroboration either. erp_gantries is an empty list, there are no toll lines and the pass-through total is SGD 0.00, so there is nothing in the fare breakdown placing the vehicle on a corridor the optimal route does not use. POL-RD-09 has nothing to correct, and POL-RD-07(ii)'s gantry limb is empty.

The trip_record figure of 15.0 km actual distance is not independent corroboration of the trace. POL-RD-01 directs that trip_record.actual_distance_km is a rounded convenience copy of the same measurement and may NOT be cited for the threshold test, and it matches the trace's own 15.0 km exactly - the billed distance is a copy of the trace figure, which POL-RD-07(ii) expressly excludes.

With no independent source in the record, POL-RD-07(iii) applies on its own terms: the claim is not sustained on the present record and the outcome is ESCALATE rather than NO_ACTION, because absence of proof on an impaired trace is a data failure and not a finding for the driver. The only artifact asserting the 4.0 km excess is the impaired EV-GPS-09115 (issue GPS_GAP, weight 0.6), and the rider's own filing concedes the map gap sits exactly where the route was left.

Escalation is in any event mandatory under POL-RD-10(3): the gps_trace is impaired under POL-RD-07(a)-(c) and no corroborating artifact of the kind POL-RD-07(ii) names exists. The trigger that fires is limb (3). What would resolve it is an independent record of the vehicle's path across the 160-second gap - a traffic advisory covering the corridor, an off-corridor ERP crossing, or an admission from either party - none of which is in this bundle.

Independently of the trace-integrity route, the deciding fact - the 4.0 km excess - is carried solely by EV-GPS-09115 at weight_multiplier 0.6. Under POL-GEN-02(2) the ruling's confidence cannot exceed the weight of the artifact that carries the deciding fact, and 0.6 is below the platform-wide 0.70 floor, so escalation under POL-RD-10(1) is automatic on the confidence cap alone.

The rider has not discharged its initial burden under POL-RD-08(b). That limb requires an excess meeting the POL-RD-01 threshold measured from an UNIMPAIRED gps_trace or, where the trace is impaired, from an independent source named in POL-RD-07(ii). Here the excess is measured only from an impaired trace and no POL-RD-07(ii) source exists, so the burden never shifts to the driver to invoke an exculpatory clause.

No traffic advisory was produced at all. EV-ADVIS-09115-01 is MISSING, with issue code MISSING_ARTIFACT and weight 0.0, so it can carry no fact. POL-RD-03 requires a traffic_advisory naming a road the optimal route traverses, with an overlapping validity window and a trace that leaves and rejoins the corridor; with the artifact absent, the external-cause hypothesis cannot be tested on this record in either direction, which is itself a data gap pointing to human review rather than an automatic refund.

Even taken at face value, the arithmetic does not yield a material deviation. The excess is 4.0 km and 36.4%, which passes the POL-RD-01 establishment tests (greater than 20% and greater than 0.8 km) but fails BOTH materiality tests (greater than 50% or greater than 8.0 km). POL-RD-06 is therefore not engaged on this trip, and the rider has no route to the POL-RD-06(b) FULL_REFUND uplift; the ceiling on this claim remains the POL-RD-02 partial.

The driver's own trailing-window counters show no repeat-deviation pattern. driver_profile.deviation_flags_90d is 0 against driver_profile.completed_trips_90d of 610 - a rate of 0.00, far below the 0.05 ratio threshold and far below the 3-flag count in POL-RD-06. No pattern is established, so the balance cannot be resolved against the driver under POL-RD-06(a) and no POL-RD-06(c) conduct referral follows.

The exposure on this claim is capped regardless of how the impairment question is resolved. The fare model is METERED and the vehicle type is RYDE_X, so POL-RD-02 governs any refund rather than POL-RD-11 or POL-RD-12, and its arithmetic floor here is the SGD 5.80 the rider contests. There are no pass-through lines to add on top: ERP, tolls, airport surcharge and waiting-time fee are all SGD 0.00, and no charge line is unmatched, so POL-RD-09 yields no standalone correction.

In the alternative, and for completeness, POL-RD-07(i) directs that any excess distance across the impaired stretch be measured as the straight line between the bounding fixes - here 1.35 km across the gap - which the clause expressly identifies as the reading most favourable to the driver. The rider's assertion that the car left the route at that point is an inference drawn from a 160-second blackout, not a measurement, and the derived trace data records no sustained off-corridor speed or heading of its own.

ledger.claim: The rider has not discharged its initial burden under POL-RD-08(b). That limb requires an excess meeting the POL-RD-01 threshold measured from an UNIMPAIRED gps_trace or, where the trace is impaired, from an independent source named in POL-RD-07(ii). Here the excess is measured only from an impaired trace and no POL-RD-07(ii) source exists, so the burden never shifts to the driver to invoke an exculpatory clause.

ledger.claim: No traffic advisory was produced at all. EV-ADVIS-09115-01 is MISSING, with issue code MISSING_ARTIFACT and weight 0.0, so it can carry no fact. POL-RD-03 requires a traffic_advisory naming a road the optimal route traverses, with an overlapping validity window and a trace that leaves and rejoins the corridor; with the artifact absent, the external-cause hypothesis cannot be tested on this record in either direction, which is itself a data gap pointing to human review rather than an automatic refund.

Even taken at face value, the arithmetic does not yield a material deviation. The excess is 4.0 km and 36.4%, which passes the POL-RD-01 establishment tests (greater than 20% and greater than 0.8 km) but fails BOTH materiality tests (greater than 50% or greater than 8.0 km). POL-RD-06 is therefore not engaged on this trip, and the rider has no route to the POL-RD-06(b) FULL_REFUND uplift; the ceiling on this claim remains the POL-RD-02 partial.

ledger.claim: The driver's own trailing-window counters show no repeat-deviation pattern. driver_profile.deviation_flags_90d is 0 against driver_profile.completed_trips_90d of 610 - a rate of 0.00, far below the 0.05 ratio threshold and far below the 3-flag count in POL-RD-06. No pattern is established, so the balance cannot be resolved against the driver under POL-RD-06(a) and no POL-RD-06(c) conduct referral follows.

The exposure on this claim is capped regardless of how the impairment question is resolved. The fare model is METERED and the vehicle type is RYDE_X, so POL-RD-02 governs any refund rather than POL-RD-11 or POL-RD-12, and its arithmetic floor here is the SGD 5.80 the rider contests. There are no pass-through lines to add on top: ERP, tolls, airport surcharge and waiting-time fee are all SGD 0.00, and no charge line is unmatched, so POL-RD-09 yields no standalone correction.

In the alternative, and for completeness, POL-RD-07(i) directs that any excess distance across the impaired stretch be measured as the straight line between the bounding fixes - here 1.35 km across the gap - which the clause expressly identifies as the reading most favourable to the driver. The rider's assertion that the car left the route at that point is an inference drawn from a 160-second blackout, not a measurement, and the derived trace data records no sustained off-corridor speed or heading of its own.
